request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for 12 months of production maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance and Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for an Intersect budget administration fee.

The requested work is limited to maintaining hardware-wallet compatibility, tooling, security, release support, supporting libraries, and vendor-required assurance rather than building a new wallet product.
The proposer states that continuous hardware-wallet maintenance is needed because Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor changes could otherwise break secure user and integrator access.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, including a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified on-chain addresses.

The proposal says oversight will involve five Intersect admin roles, three Intersect leadership roles, and six external entities: Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.
The proposal lists multi-party authorization thresholds for funding, disbursement, pause/resume, sweep, and reorganize actions on the treasury smart contracts.

The proposal discloses prior treasury and Catalyst funding related to hardware wallets, Ledger app rewrite, Plutus enhancement, security, token, and developer ecosystem work through several linked records.
The proposer claims the work aligns with Cardano strategic pillars around security, interoperability, developer experience, adoption, and secure UX.

summary: The document describes a 1,310,960 ada treasury request submitted by Intersect for 2026 hardware-wallet maintenance, with broad technical scope, smart-contract-based fund administration, external oversight claims, and several links for voting, audits, prior funding, and treasury tooling.
